name: secure-centric/accordion-faq
title: FAQ Accordion (Interactive)
description: Interactive animated accordion of defense contractor CMMC questions and expert answers.

description.default: Still have questions regarding your specific CMMC clauses or audit dates? Speak directly with our lead Registered Practitioner.

faq1A.default: CMMC (Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification) is the Department of War standard ensuring defense contractors safeguard Federal Contract Information (FCI) and Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI).

faq2Q.default: Do you come to our site?

faq2A.default: Yes, absolutely. An on-site facility walkthrough is step 1 of every engagement. We inspect physical boundaries, server rooms, and shop-floor terminals in person.

faq3Q.default: Do you only work on CMMC and NIST SP 800-171?

faq3A.default: Our Cyber AB Registered Practitioners conduct in-depth scoping and compliance reviews to guarantee defensible alignment with Department of War standards.

faq4Q.default: What happens after I book a discovery call?

faq4A.default: Having your prime contract Section I DFARS clauses (e.g. 252.204-7012, 7019, 7020), your high-level network topology, and whether you handle CUI or FCI will make the call most productive.

faq5Q.default: Who will we work with day to day?

faq5A.default: Our Cyber AB Registered Practitioners conduct in-depth scoping and compliance reviews to guarantee defensible alignment with Department of War standards.
